original.statement: If you use Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 and are upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older, enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and switch to StrimziPodSets before upgrading to 0.46.0.

decision.reason: [ev-17b3774eb9ee] limits the instruction to environments that use Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 and are upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older. The proposed exposure matches both conditions: an upgrade starting below 0.39.0, and KafkaConnect or KafkaMirrorMaker2 resources in use. The evidence does not say what state the feature gate is in by default, and it does not say how to tell whether StrimziPodSets are in use. So adding an "already compliant" exclusion or a shielded (overlap) case would rest on facts the evidence does not give, and the condition as proposed is the scope the text supports.
